import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_3.csv"
]

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(path, index_col=0) for path in source_files]

# According to operation_history: UNION of Source5_38_0, Source5_38_1, Source5_38_2, Source5_38_3
# All have the same schema: ['missing_count', 'state', 'latitude', 'longitude']

# Concatenate (union) all dataframes
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Target schema: ['state': string, 'missing_count': integer, 'latitude': integer, 'longitude': integer]
# Current columns: ['missing_count', 'state', 'latitude', 'longitude']

# Reorder columns to match target schema order
union_df = union_df[['state', 'missing_count', 'latitude', 'longitude']]

# Convert data types according to target schema
union_df['state'] = union_df['state'].astype(str)
union_df['missing_count'] = union_df['missing_count'].astype(int)
# latitude and longitude in target are integers, so convert by rounding
union_df['latitude'] = union_df['latitude'].round().astype(int)
union_df['longitude'] = union_df['longitude'].round().astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/target_multisource.csv"
union_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSVs with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_38_0 and Source5_38_1 on 'state'
join_01 = pd.merge(source0, source1, on='state', suffixes=('_0', '_1'))

# Join Source5_38_2 and Source5_38_3 on 'state'
join_23 = pd.merge(source2, source3, on='state', suffixes=('_2', '_3'))

# Join the above two results on 'state'
join_0123 = pd.merge(join_01, join_23, on='state')

# Join the above with Source5_38_4 on 'state'
full_join = pd.merge(join_0123, source4, on='state', suffixes=('', '_4'))

# Now aggregate to get one row per state
# Group by 'state' (primary key)
# Aggregate missing_count, latitude, longitude by min (to get consistent values)
result = full_join.groupby('state', as_index=False).agg({
    'missing_count_0': 'min',
    'latitude_0': 'min',
    'longitude_0': 'min'
})

# Rename columns to match target schema
result = result.rename(columns={
    'missing_count_0': 'missing_count',
    'latitude_0': 'latitude',
    'longitude_0': 'longitude'
})

# Write to target CSV
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
